page.notes: The Greek phrase "μακάριε τῶ ϑεοπνεύστῳ" is only partly legible at this scan resolution; the letters are copied as seen, without certainty. "oppositè" is italic and its final accent is doubtful. The word "vsurpata" in the phrase "in Græcia vsurpata, legibus" and the italic status of "vernacula" in "in Sacris vsitata vernacula" are uncertain. The line-end "homi-" is a printed hyphen, and the catchword "nes" completes it.
